rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for running or administering an organization.

example.english: Good company management makes it easier to reach goals.
example.traditional: 公司管理做得好，先至容易達到目標。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gun2 lei5 zou6 dak1 hou2 sin1 zi3 jung4 ji6 daat6 dou3 muk6 biu1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the managers or senior executives as a group.

example.english: The management decided to raise salaries next month.
example.traditional: 管理層決定下個月加人工。
example.jyutping: gun2 lei5 cang4 kyut3 ding6 haa6 go3 jyut6 gaa1 jan4 gung1

rows.meaning: careful use of time or resources
rows.note: Use this for the careful organization and use of one's time.

example.english: When you have a lot of work, time management becomes even more important.
example.traditional: 做嘢多，時間管理就更加重要。
example.jyutping: zou6 je5 do1 si4 gaan3 gun2 lei5 zau6 gang3 gaa1 zung6 jiu3

rows.meaning: careful use of time or resources
rows.note: Use this when the means being managed are resources rather than time.

example.english: Only with good resource management can we make good use of limited resources.
example.traditional: 要做好資源管理，先可以善用有限資源。
example.jyutping: jiu3 zou6 hou2 zi1 jyun4 gun2 lei5 sin1 ho2 ji5 sin6 jung6 jau5 haan6 zi1 jyun4
